source.title: WCA Regulations - January 2024
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Regulations Committee would like to inform you about the new version of the WCA Regulations and Guidelines, which are going into effect on **January 1st, 2024**.

You can review all changes in [this comparison on GitHub](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official-2023-08-01...official-2024-01-01). You can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the Regulations and Guidelines, where all changes and additions are marked green and removals are marked red.

**You can view a more detailed announcement in this [WCA Forum post](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/wca-regulations-january-2024/44048)**. Below is a *summary* of the changes in the new version of the Regulations and the Guidelines.

**Major Changes:**

- Allow competitors to push Clock pins during inspection ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1173/files)).
- Allow 5x5 Cube misscrambles in competition under stronger discretion of the WCA Delegate ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1176/files)).
- Add an official Visual Guide for Regulation 3j ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1174/files)).
- Allow the region of representation to change at any moment under some circumstances ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1177/files)).


**Minor Changes:**

- Clarify what “using” means in 2i ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1180/files)) and remove 2i3 ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1160/files)).
- Clarify the starting state of puzzles for Fewest Moves Solving ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1164/files)).
- Explicitly allow multiple logos placed on one piece for speedsolving events ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1153/files)).
- Clarify inspection time frame – border cases grant greater penalty ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1166/files)).
- Change the recording of pre-solve penalties ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1169/files)).
- Clarify circumstances in which 2s can be applied ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1168/files)).
- Make regulations regarding cameras more lenient ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1182/files)).
- Clarify spectators interacting with popped pieces  ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1152/files)).
- Update 2h ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1154/files)).
- Add a requirement to check for duplicate scrambles for Multi-Blind Solving ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1155/files)).
- Change “country” to “region” ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1156/files)).
- Allow competitors to contact WRT through a Delegate in 2c2 ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1161/files)).
- Remove 3j+ ([changes](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1165/files))

Along with the changes above, a new version of TNoodle, the official WCA scrambling program, will be released. Pin states will no longer be included in official scrambles. The new version will go into effect on **January 1st, 2024**, at the same time with the new Regulations and Guidelines.

translation.title: WCA 规则更新：2024 年 1 月
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 规则委员会在此介绍新版《WCA 规则与指南》，新版将于 **2024 年 1 月 1 日**生效。

全部改动可通过 [GitHub 上的对比](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official-2023-08-01...official-2024-01-01)查看。点击“Files changed”即可查看《规则》和《指南》的完整文件；修改和新增内容标为绿色，删除内容标为红色。

**更详细的公告见[这篇 WCA 论坛帖子](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/wca-regulations-january-2024/44048)。**以下是新版《规则》和《指南》的改动*摘要*。

**主要改动：**

- 允许选手在观察阶段按动魔表的针脚（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1173/files)）。
- 对五阶错打乱的处理，赋予 WCA 代表更大的裁量空间，允许在一定情况下保留该次还原（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1176/files)）。
- 为规则 3j 增加官方图解指南（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1174/files)）。
- 在特定情况下，允许选手随时变更所代表的地区（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1177/files)）。

**次要改动：**

- 明确 2i 中“使用”的含义（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1180/files)），并删除 2i3（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1160/files)）。
- 明确最少步比赛中魔方的初始状态（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1164/files)）。
- 明确允许速拧项目所用魔方在同一块上放置多个标志（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1153/files)）。
- 明确观察时长的界限：恰好达到临界时刻时，适用较重的处罚（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1166/files)）。
- 修改还原前处罚的记录方式（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1169/files)）。
- 明确 2s 的适用情形（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1168/files)）。
- 放宽有关摄像设备的规定（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1182/files)）。
- 明确观众接触飞出零件时的处理（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1152/files)）。
- 更新 2h（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1154/files)）。
- 增加检查三阶多盲打乱是否重复的要求（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1155/files)）。
- 将“国家”改为“地区”（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1156/files)）。
- 在 2c2 中，允许选手通过代表联系 WRT（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1161/files)）。
- 删除 3j+（[改动](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1165/files)）。

配合上述调整，WCA 官方打乱程序 TNoodle 也将发布新版本。官方打乱将不再包含魔表针脚状态。新版 TNoodle 将与新版《规则与指南》同时于 **2024 年 1 月 1 日**生效。
